name: proof.storageFieldIncrementAssignment.overflow-step-dropped.1
diff:

+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -608,3 +608,3 @@
       dl{ ⟨[ v = sp.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝
-          { storage := save(storage, sp.fld, sp.fld ± 1) ‖ v := sp.fld⊕⊕ } ⟨[ ]⟩ }

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.storageFieldIncrementAssignment: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.alias i✝) fld✝ hfld✝) hs✝)
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    ((Upd.nil.snoc
          (UpdElem.storage
            (Tms.STerm.save Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)
              (Tms.SValT.val
                (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)))))).snoc
      (UpdElem.local v✝
        (Rhs.val
          (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝
            (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝))))))

case alias
C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
v✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.val p✝)
op✝ : IncDec
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ fld✝ : Name
hfld✝ : C✝.fieldType x✝ fld✝ = some (Ty.prim p✝)
i✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.alias (RefTy.struct x✝))
hs✝ : (OpLoc.field (SPath.alias i✝) fld✝ hfld✝).recvSimple = true
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.alias i✝) fld✝ hfld✝) hs✝) =
    Premise.update
      ((Upd.nil.snoc
            (UpdElem.storage
              (Tms.STerm.save Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)
                (Tms.SValT.val
                  (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)))))).snoc
        (UpdElem.local v✝
          (Rhs.val
            (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝
              (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝))))))
